summary:
The year is 2051. An international mission arrives at the lunar south pole to establish a permanent base. However, an error during landing sends a cargo module off course, leaving several essential systems incomplete.

Orion wakes from a cryogenic chamber and discovers that he has 180 Sols until the next supply shipment arrives.
details: The game intends for the player to learn how to manage limited resources in a lunar base. The impact of the project is intended to help kids (or a general younger audience) to get in contact with resource management, along with science and STEM. The main tools in the game are crop production, energy management and vital support aspects. The game is written in GDScript with the Godot Engine for 2D games. My team considered the art, the implementation of NASA data and the creative aspect of the overall game.
dataRefs: Biomass Production of the EDEN ISS Space Greenhouse in Antarctica During the 2018 Experiment Phase
projectRefs: Toolkit for educators and youth – Food production on the Moon and in remote areas
